purpose: Teach: 特区/能率/退席/実演/私見/既成/中長期/振替

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、新興特区に出店を検討されたぞ
lines.en: When we were founding the company, you considered opening a branch in the new development zone.
lines.style: Measured, reflective recall. Gentle weight on the memory. Pauses slightly before the key detail. Not lecturing — offering back what he remembers.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは能率重視で社員を導かれた
lines.en: Yes. Father led the staff with efficiency as his north star.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Respectful tone, speaking of the past with composed admiration. Steady pace, no rush. A son acknowledging his father's principle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、会議の途中退席を許されなかった
lines.en: He never left a meeting early, no matter what.
lines.style: Slight wistfulness in the voice. Not sad — appreciative of the discipline. Soft emphasis on the commitment. Trailing off gently at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新商品の実演を自ら行われた
lines.en: Yes. Father demonstrated every new product himself.
lines.style: Calm affirmation with quiet pride underneath. Deliberate pace — letting the weight of that choice settle. Not boastful, just factual respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員に私見を求められたぞ
lines.en: He asked his staff for their personal opinions. He valued what they thought.
lines.style: Voice carries a note of admiration and slight sadness. Slow delivery on the main clause. Trails off as if still processing what that generosity meant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは既成にとらわれない経営をされた
lines.en: Yes. Father wasn't bound by convention in how he ran things.
lines.style: Steady, measured affirmation. Slight emphasis on the independence of his thinking. Warm tone — not defensive, just stating a truth with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、中長期の構想を持たれてたぞ
lines.en: He always thought in terms of years ahead, not just what was in front of him.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost meditative. Slight pause before 'years ahead.' Voice carries the weight of long-term vision. Trails softly, like a reflection settling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは振替手続きにも厳密でいらした
lines.en: Yes. In everything — even the small procedures — Father was rigorous. That was his way.
lines.style: Final affirmation, grave and gentle. Slow, deliberate pace. Weight on 'rigorous.' Voice softens at the end — a closing thought, full of understanding.
